name: Semiconductor Device Physics
notes: Focus on MOSFET I-V characteristics and CMOS fabrication steps relevant to FPGA process nodes.

name: FPGA Fabric Architecture
notes: Vendor-agnostic but use Xilinx/AMD and Intel references for concrete slice diagrams.

name: Digital Logic Recap
notes: Recap for working engineers; emphasize metastability and clock-domain crossing intuition.

name: CMOS Switching, Delay and Power Models
notes: Logical effort, RC delay networks, and their impact on FPGA critical path estimation.

name: Signal Integrity and Transmission Line Fundamentals
notes: Impedance control, reflection coefficient, crosstalk modeling in high-speed FPGA interfaces.

name: Clock Domains, Skew, Jitter and Clock Distribution
notes: PLL/DLL principles, global vs regional clock buffers in modern FPGAs.

name: Linear Algebra for Hardware
notes: Matrix ops, SVD, and how they map to systolic array layouts.

name: Fixed-Point Arithmetic and Number Representation
notes: Qm.n format, overflow/saturation, guard bits for DSP accumulators.

name: Probability and Statistics for Quantization and Noise
notes: SQNR derivation, uniform quantization error distribution, entropy coding basics.

name: Numerical Analysis for Hardware
notes: Stability of iterative methods, truncation vs round-off, condition number relevance.

name: Verilog RTL Design
notes: Blocking vs nonblocking, generate blocks, parameterization; use IEEE 1364-2005 / SystemVerilog subset.

name: Simulation, Testbenches and Verification
notes: Self-checking testbenches, cocotb with Python, basic SystemVerilog assertions.

name: Timing Analysis and Constraints
notes: SDC commands, setup/hold slack, false paths, multi-cycle path definitions.

name: FPGA Synthesis and Place-and-Route Internals
notes: Academic algorithms: technology mapping, simulated annealing placement, pathfinder routing.

name: Python for Algorithm Prototyping
notes: NumPy/SciPy DSP modeling, bit-true golden reference generation.

name: Julia for Scientific Computing and Hardware-Aware Numerics
notes: Tullio, LoopVectorization, and writing fixed-point simulations in Julia.

name: MATLAB/Simulink for Hardware Modeling
notes: Fixed-Point Designer settings, HDL Coder workflow, ModelSim cosimulation.

name: Hardware-Centric Data Structures
notes: Synchronous FIFO (dual-port RAM based), CAM, LFSR, crossbar arbitration.

name: Parallel Algorithms for Hardware
notes: Systolic array design, dataflow graph scheduling, throughput/latency trade-offs.

name: Memory Hierarchy and Interface Design
notes: AXI4 / AXI-Stream, BRAM vs URAM, DDR/HBM controller basics.

name: DSP Kernels on FPGA
notes: FIR / IIR filter architectures, pipelined FFT (Radix-2/4), CORDIC in Verilog.

name: Quantization and Pruning for ML on FPGA
notes: INT8/INT4/ternary, PTQ vs QAT, AdaRound and BRECQ fundamentals for HW.

name: CNN Accelerators on FPGA
notes: Loop tiling/unrolling, Winograd, dataflow mapping (row-stationary), NVDLA-style architectures.

name: Transformer Acceleration on FPGA
notes: MHSA systolic mapping, linear attention approximations, KV-cache memory management; frontier topic.

name: Sparse and Irregular Computation on FPGA
notes: Sparse matrix formats, SpMV hardware units, load-balancing and scheduling.

name: Network-on-Chip for Multi-FPGA HPC
notes: Mesh/torus, wormhole switching, deadlock-free routing for FPGA clusters.

name: FPGA Emulation and Co-simulation
notes: Verilator DPI-C, cocotb, QEMU SoC emulation; Python/Julia cosimulation bindings.

name: Roofline Model and Performance Analysis on FPGA
notes: Operational intensity metrics, AXI bandwidth profiling, roofline plotting for FPGA designs.

name: Reconfigurable Computing and Dynamic Partial Reconfiguration
notes: Partial reconfiguration region design, ICAP/PCAP, adaptive compute on modern Xilinx/AMD parts.

name: Advanced Board-Level Power Integrity and Thermal Coupling
notes: PDN design, decoupling capacitors, SSN (ground bounce), thermal via design.
